PM5E.Import.Title: Import from Mephistopheles Terminal
PM5E.Import.Hint: Paste a macro or JSON from the site (the “Foundry” button in the Knowledge Base, “TO FOUNDRY” in the builder) or pick a file. Everything goes to the “Mephistopheles Terminal” folder; documents imported before are updated.
PM5E.Import.Bad: This doesn't look like Mephistopheles Terminal data: use a macro or JSON from the site.
PM5E.Import.Fail: Mephistopheles Terminal: import failed, see the console (F12).
PM5E.Settings.SiteUrlHint: Where Knowledge Base records open from. Filled in automatically on the first import.
